title: Prove distinct gate clauses as def-axioms; fix one-argument distinct
summary: The clause-log exporter now emits the two gate clauses of a distinct below the root as def-axiom nodes, which the Lean reconstructor proves from the pairwise disequalities instead of through an unsat-core cnf lemma and a solver call. A one-argument distinct, which Z3 rewrites to true, now reconstructs in Lean on both proof paths.
